title: Roll out security hardening env vars and Supabase grants
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The code-level hardening for public API exposure has been implemented locally, but production still needs an operational rollout. Railway/Vercel/Supabase must be updated so the new protections are actually enforced in live environments.

Acceptance criteria:
- ADMIN_API_KEY is set in Railway and documented for operators
- BHX_API_BEARER_TOKEN and BHX_API_X_API_KEY are set before re-enabling live BHX crawl
- The new Supabase migration is applied to the linked project so publishable-key reads can access curated public views
- /api/health stays public and minimal, while /api/health/details requires the admin key in production
- Manual verification confirms public refresh endpoints are no longer callable without admin authorization

title: Harden public API and runtime security surface
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The live Vercel/Railway deployment exposes several security weaknesses in the public API and runtime configuration. We need to remediate the verified findings from the security review: block path traversal in vn-prices history access, require explicit authorization for privileged refresh/admin endpoints, stop using the Supabase service role as the default read client, reduce operational data exposure from health endpoints, move BHX credentials out of source code, and address the production xlsx dependency vulnerability.

Acceptance criteria:
- Public history endpoint only accepts safe date keys and cannot read arbitrary JSON files
- Admin or mutation endpoints require explicit server-side authorization and no longer rely on public access
- Read-only Supabase queries use the read client instead of silently escalating to service role
- Public health output no longer exposes sensitive operational details; detailed health is protected
- Hard-coded BHX credentials are removed from source and loaded from environment with safe fallback behavior
- Production dependency risk around xlsx is mitigated or the vulnerable path is removed/replaced

notes: Reviewed the frontend/backend data flow and tightened it around the Supabase curated layer. VN summaries still use latest_observation_details for row-level detail retention (especially rice varieties), but now derive aggregate signals from daily_price_summary and commodity_trends instead of relying on raw_payload previousPrice. World responses now expose curated metadata (status, sourceMode, lastUpdated) and pass through priceVndKg from latest_world_prices_public so the frontend no longer guesses VND conversions client-side. Updated the world page/table to use server-provided categories, status, timestamps, and VND/kg reference pricing. Verified with server typecheck, lint, build, and a smoke test returning live curated data for both VN and world endpoints.

title: Kiem tra luu bai viet va bat lich crawl tin tuc
description: Xac minh bai viet tin tuc dang duoc luu ben vung trong Supabase va bat crawl scheduler neu chua duoc cau hinh.

title: Chuẩn hóa toàn bộ tiếng Việt có dấu trên website
description: Rà soát toàn bộ giao diện và nội dung web để tìm các chuỗi tiếng Việt đang thiếu dấu hoặc viết không chuẩn, sửa lại nhất quán để mọi chỗ dùng tiếng Việt đều có dấu đầy đủ. Bao gồm kiểm tra component frontend, metadata, nội dung tĩnh và thông báo hiển thị cho người dùng.

title: Remove khuyennong source and move source attribution into article detail
description: User requested removing Khuyen nong Viet Nam because the site has low content volume, backfilling roughly 20 older articles from the remaining news sources, and removing source labels from listing/card surfaces so attribution appears only at the bottom of the article detail page.

title: Use live fallback cache for real news articles
description: Replace hardcoded 5-article fallback behavior with a live-cache fallback that crawls real agriculture news sources when Supabase news tables are unavailable or empty. Also add resilient image fallback handling in the news UI so broken or missing thumbnails do not render as empty cards.

title: Refine relevance filtering for generic news sources
description: The new news ingestion pipeline currently crawls generic feeds/sitemaps for sources like VietnamBiz and Cong Thuong. Add source-specific discovery URLs or stronger agriculture relevance filtering so these sources consistently ingest only agriculture/news-market articles instead of broad site content.

title: Build news ingestion and news homepage
description: Implement a dedicated news ingestion pipeline, Supabase schema, public/admin news APIs, and a news homepage/detail experience that becomes the primary root route and first navbar tab. Scope includes source registry, Phase 1 source ingestion, article storage, listing/detail UI, and route/navbar migration from / to /bang-gia for the existing dashboard.

title: Remove stale khuyennongtphcm wholesale source
description: Why: The khuyennongtphcm wholesale bulletin source only yields stale 2024 data and cannot pass ingestion freshness validation. What: remove the source from active crawlers, source typing/mapping, scripts, and aggregation until fresher data exists.

title: Add official wholesale market bulletin crawlers
description: Why: The project needs dedicated wholesale market sources instead of relying only on news/ecommerce feeds. What: add crawlers for khuyennongtphcm.vn market bulletins and Dong Nai SCT Dầu Giây bulletins, wire them into source metadata/orchestration, and verify parsing for HTML/PDF bulletin formats.

title: Stabilize Co.op sync on legacy Supabase schema
description: Co.op live crawl succeeds, but repeated sync attempts can fail with transient fetch/ECONNRESET after or during Supabase writes. The remote Supabase schema still lacks modern dedupe_key/source_name/price_chain_summary support, so naive whole-run retries are not duplicate-safe. Add targeted retry strategy and/or remote schema rollout so Co.op sync can be rerun safely and consistently.
close_reason: Co.op and legacy Supabase sync now tolerate transient network failures and reruns reconcile duplicates safely

title: Implement Co.op retail crawler and price-chain view
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done: implement the approved Co.op retail crawler, Supabase sync path, price-chain API/page, env loading fix for server scripts, and end-to-end verification for Co.op + BHX + Customs.
close_reason: Implemented Co.op retail crawl, Supabase compatibility fixes, and /chuoi-gia price-chain UI with verified local API/UI tests

title: Fix ingestion duplicates and BHX commodity seed gaps
description: Why: Supabase ingestion verification shows 3 duplicate errors in the VN live bundle and 9 BHX unknown_commodity failures because several crawler slugs are not seeded in commodities. What: inspect dedupe fingerprinting for VN rice rows, add any required commodity seeds/mappings for BHX retail rows, verify end-to-end ingestion on local Supabase, and push the fix.

title: Fix customs PDF discovery pattern
description: Why: the live customs crawler cannot find an export PDF during pattern discovery and returns zero items. What: inspect the current URL pattern against the live customs file host, update discovery to resolve the correct report URL, and verify the crawler with a dry-run.

title: Harden BHX live crawl and multi-region coverage
description: Why: phase 1 BHX support is implemented with fixture coverage and a validated HCM live probe, but live behavior remains environment-sensitive and multi-region resolution still depends on BHX network stability. What: validate BHX live crawl across the configured regions, tune retry/page-size behavior, and document the operational expectations for scheduler rollout. Acceptance: at least the configured production regions are verified live, crawl stability is measured, and the BHX runbook/config defaults are updated with the final rollout guidance.
close_reason: BHX live crawl now uses browser request-context API fetch, resolves all configured regions, and syncs successfully to Supabase

title: Implement BHX retail crawler phase 1
description: Why: the source research phase identified Bach Hoa Xanh as the highest-value next retail source and the implementation plan has been reviewed with required scope adjustments. What: add BHX crawler infrastructure, seed the approved retail commodities, wire scheduler/script support, and integrate retail observations into the existing Supabase-backed read path without shipping Co.op Online or piece-based egg handling in this phase. Acceptance: BHX crawl can run in fixture mode and live single-region mode, seeded commodities ingest successfully, scheduler and ops scripts expose BHX state, and the API/read path can surface retail observations in the intended manner for the implemented scope.
close_reason: BHX phase 1 implementation is complete in code, and the earlier source-research work has been absorbed into the reviewed implementation and follow-up hardening ticket.

title: Stabilize Shopee live crawl egress and manual challenge workflow
description: Why: the Shopee browser-backed session flow and scheduler are implemented, but live crawl is still blocked by Shopee anti-bot payload 90309999 in the current environment. What: validate proxy strategy, test cleaner production egress, and document/automate the manual headed refresh workflow so Shopee can move from blocked-safe to production-live. Acceptance: there is a validated production egress/session procedure for Shopee, live crawl can reach a healthy session in at least one target environment, and the runbook is updated with the final operating procedure.

title: Integrate Shopee and customs crawlers into v2 ingestion pipeline
description: Why: extend the current market data pipeline with retail data from Shopee and export data from customs while preserving legacy dashboard behavior and fitting the v2 price model. What: design the integration contract, update source and slug mappings, adapt ingestion identity/bounds, implement customs first, then Shopee, and verify curated views and backward compatibility. Acceptance: integration design is finalized, customs and Shopee sources can be ingested through the existing pipeline, and legacy dashboard output remains stable.

title: Remove abbreviations and English names from UI
description: As requested by user, remove abbreviation codes and English names from the commodity list in PriceTable and other components.

title: Refactor Supabase data model to v2 with backward-compatible legacy dashboard
description: Why: adopt the new 5-layer price data model from data-model-v2.md while preserving the existing legacy VN price dashboard contract and avoiding runtime regressions. What: add a new Supabase migration for v2 fields/views/backfills, update ingestion/service code from market_type/source to price_type/source_type/source_name, expand world_prices, and keep legacy dashboard queries/views working via compatibility views or service adaptation. Acceptance: migration applies cleanly, existing dashboard API remains functional, new v2 schema objects exist, and sample ingestion still works.

title: Harden aggregation quality for phase 1 crawl sources
description: Review and improve aggregation quality, source ranking, and conflict handling for the newly added phase 1 crawl sources so combined VN price summaries remain sensible after adding aggregate-national and local-market sources.

title: Implement phase 1 agricultural source crawlers
description: Implement phase 1 crawl expansion: add VPSA spice prices, banggianongsan price pages, and if feasible giaca.nsvl homepage tables. Extend seeded commodities and ingestion mappings as needed. Evaluate vietfood as a rice-price source during implementation and defer only if parsing is materially harder than phase 1 sources.

title: Research new agricultural data crawl sources
description: Research candidate websites for expanding agricultural market data ingestion sources, assess feasibility, data coverage, crawl strategy, and risks, then propose an implementation plan before any code changes.
close_reason: BHX phase 1 implementation is complete in code, and the earlier source-research work has been absorbed into the reviewed implementation and follow-up hardening ticket.

title: Refine web security skill from full prompt
description: Update the project web-security skill now that claude promt generated/web-security.md contains the full security audit prompt. Fold in any materially better methodology, risk coverage, and reporting structure without bloating the skill.

title: Create web security skill for project
description: Build a reusable project skill for web security guidance and enforcement. The skill must trigger when explicitly requested and when Codex is implementing security-sensitive web features such as auth, sessions, file upload, secrets, Supabase RLS, admin operations, input handling, redirects, HTML rendering, payments, or external webhooks.

title: Complete ingestion validation pipeline
description: Implement the remaining ingestion-validation workflow from the prompt in the existing TypeScript/Supabase server. Current repo already has direct Supabase sync and partial normalization/bounds logic, but is missing freshness checks, duplicate detection against DB, spike detection, queue/worker processing, and monitoring. Add the missing pipeline pieces in repo style and verify with targeted checks.
design: Reuse existing crawler and Supabase abstractions, implement pipeline in TypeScript rather than introducing Python, keep legacy fallback paths intact.
acceptance_criteria: Server includes a reusable ingestion pipeline with bounds, freshness, duplicate, spike, and confidence handling; crawlers enqueue raw messages when admin Supabase is configured; worker consumes queue and writes observations/errors; monitoring script reports queue depth/errors/recent records; lint/build succeed.

title: Remove unused navigation tabs
description: Remove 'Thị trường' and 'Phân tích' tabs from Navbar and Footer as they are currently unused.

title: Fix world category mojibake and Supabase RLS hardening
description: Fix the mojibake literal in the world prices category filter and harden the Supabase migration RLS/security-definer setup after review.
close_reason: Fixed world category mojibake and hardened Supabase RLS/function/view security; build and lint pass, Supabase reset blocked by missing Docker.

title: Connect Vite marketplace to Supabase using env keys
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done:\nThe project has Supabase credentials in .env but the Vite client is not connected and marketplace data is still mocked. Implement a Supabase client using the existing env values and wire the marketplace listing read/write flow to Supabase with safe client-side configuration.

title: Improve mobile portrait usability for VN dashboard
description: Why: the user needs the dashboard verified on phone portrait layout, with key actions positioned closer to thumb reach and the interface remaining usable on both desktop and mobile. What: audit the current responsive behavior, reproduce issues at mobile viewport sizes, adjust layout and action placement, then verify the updated UI in portrait mode and desktop mode.

title: Fix NaN change values breaking TopMovers runtime
description: Why: headless browser verification of the VN dashboard found a runtime crash in TopMovers because some crawled rows use '-' for change values, which currently parse to NaN and later serialize to null in the API response. What: sanitize crawler change parsing and harden summary aggregation so live payloads always emit finite numeric change fields.

title: Harden secondary coffee source when giacaphe blocks crawler
description: Why: the VN prices implementation is live, but giacaphe.com currently returns a Cloudflare challenge to server-side requests, so the secondary source remains unavailable in production-like verification. What: evaluate an alternate secondary coffee source or a compliant fetch strategy, then restore true dual-source comparison for coffee regions.

title: Configure automatic GitHub sync workflow
description: Why: the repository currently has no git remote or auto-publish workflow. What: connect this repo to the requested GitHub repository, add a safe auto-push workflow for committed changes, and document a manual sync path for full add/commit/push publishing.

title: Follow up durian asset and variety-aware location pages
description: Durian V1 ships with fruit fallback imagery and intentionally skips generated location pages for /gia-nong-san/sau-rieng/* to avoid misleading cross-variety aggregation. Follow-up should add a dedicated durian image asset and reopen location page generation only after the page model can segment by variety and grade per location.

title: Fix duplicate validation warnings in admin report
description: Admin report shows two warning chips for the same VN price crawler validation failures because droppedCount currently mirrors validation failures. Update warning generation so the report does not duplicate the same signal.

title: Evaluate direct-site fallback crawlers for wholesale markets
description: Why: The official bulletin sources now cover Hóc Môn, Thủ Đức, Bình Điền, and Dầu Giây, but direct site fallbacks remain unimplemented. What: assess and, if worthwhile, add fallback crawlers for thuducagromarket.com, chodaumoibinhdien.com.vn, and related market-owned sites to improve resiliency when bulletin feeds go stale.

title: Optimize Supabase RLS policies flagged by advisors
description: Why: supabase db advisors --local reports pre-existing RLS performance warnings, including auth_rls_initplan on several tables and multiple permissive SELECT policies on price_observations and world_prices. What: update the relevant policies to use (select auth.<fn>()) patterns where applicable and reduce overlapping permissive policies without changing the access model.

title: Build advanced value-chain dashboard on top of price_chain_summary
description: Why: the v2 data model now supports multiple price layers (farm_gate, wholesale, retail, export, world), but the current legacy dashboard intentionally remains unchanged. What: design and implement a new advanced dashboard that reads from price_chain_summary and related v2 curated views to show chain spreads, layer comparisons, and world/export context without disturbing the legacy experience.

title: Add Supabase ingestion result verifier
description: Add a local script that checks Supabase for recent price_observations and ingestion_errors created by the ingestion sample scenarios, so end-to-end queue verification does not require manual table inspection.
design: Use server-side supabase-js with specific filters and client-side JSON filtering for ingestion_errors to avoid schema changes.
acceptance_criteria: Repo includes a verifier script that can find recent observation/error rows for a tagged ingestion sample run, package scripts expose it, and README documents the flow.

title: Add end-to-end ingestion test script
description: Add a small non-interactive script that enqueues sample VN price messages into the ingestion Redis stream so the new worker pipeline can be verified locally end-to-end. Document how to run it with the worker and monitor.
design: Keep it in the server TypeScript workspace and reuse existing queue/message types rather than introducing a separate toolchain.
acceptance_criteria: Repo includes a script that pushes at least one valid sample message to price:raw, supports predictable local verification, and README explains the worker/test/monitor flow.

title: Validate Supabase hardening migration with local Docker stack
description: Run npm run supabase:reset or equivalent migration validation once Docker Desktop is available; current environment cannot reach dockerDesktopLinuxEngine.

title: Extend Congthuong coverage beyond coffee and heo hoi
description: Why: congthuong.vn is now integrated as a trusted validation source, but the first implementation only covers coffee and live pig prices because those article formats are stable enough to parse reliably. What: evaluate current congthuong.vn article structure for pepper and domestic rice, then add parsers if the content remains consistently machine-readable without introducing fragile scraping logic.
